observations: Red gas cylinder with two vertical handles.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its safe re-filling date.
risks.proof: A photo of the date stamp on the valve or the cylinder body.

risks.risk: The valve may be leaking or the cylinder may be damaged internally.
risks.proof: A video showing the valve being opened and closed without gas escaping.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than LPG (propane).
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder label showing the gas type and manufacturer.

proof_requests: Photo of the date stamp on the valve or the cylinder body.
Photo of the label on the cylinder showing the gas type and manufacturer.
Video of the valve being operated to confirm it is not leaking.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
